title: Zones: maps that count as one place, and party splits your way
summary: DMs decide which maps are the same place and what happens when a player's move would split the party.
items: A new Zones editor groups maps into one place: a city with its districts and the maps under it, or any maps you choose.
Moving inside a zone never splits the party; coming back to the party's place rejoins it.
When a player heads into a neighbouring zone, your rule decides: block it, wait until the end of the session, or let the party vote.
Party votes are anonymous, a tie keeps the party together, and you can approve or reject any vote.
Places further away say how long the trip takes and offer to propose a journey.
